annotation.title_clean: Building trust in AI through a cyber risk-based approach
annotation.title_en: Building trust in AI through a cyber risk-based approach
annotation.authors_or_issuer: ANSSI (French National Cybersecurity Authority), co-signed by international cybersecurity agencies
annotation.summary_en: Joint high-level cyber risk analysis of AI systems published by France's ANSSI and co-signed by agencies from about 18 countries for the Paris AI Action Summit. It outlines AI-specific attacks (poisoning, extraction, evasion), supply-chain risks and security recommendations, and offers guidance to policy-makers.
key_provisions_or_claims: Advocates a risk-based approach and secure-by-design AI systems, building on the Secure AI Systems Development Guidelines.
Categorises AI-specific attacks as poisoning, extraction and evasion.
Identifies key risk scenarios: infrastructure compromise, supply chain attacks, lateralization via interconnections (including industrial systems acting on the physical world), and human failures.
Recommends policy-makers support security evaluation and certification based on shared standards.
Calls for continued international dialogue between cybersecurity agencies and AI Safety Institutes.
